LanguageData.MST.equippableBaseBodySizeComment: Minimum body size required to use the gear (BodySize ≥ this value). A negative value means "mounted only": body size is not compared at all and only the whitelists below apply. Takes effect on the next equip check; already-equipped weapons are not re-validated.
LanguageData.MST.equippableByRaceComment: These races can always use it. OR-ed with the apparel / hediff / gene whitelists; any single match passes, before the body-size check.
LanguageData.MST.equippableWithApparelComment: Wearing any one of these apparel items is enough to use the tier (power armor, mech suits…).
LanguageData.MST.equippableWithHediffComment: Having any one of these hediffs is enough (vanilla bionic / archotech arms work this way).
LanguageData.MST.equippableWithGeneComment: Having any one of these genes is enough (requires Biotech).
LanguageData.MST.isMountedWeaponComment: Read-only: true when the minimum body size is negative, i.e. the tier is only usable on vehicles / turret mounts.
LanguageData.MST.usedByWeaponsComment: Click to list every weapon / gear item using this heavy tier; click an entry to jump. Read-only, computed by a reverse lookup.
LanguageData.MST.heavyTierComment: The heavy tier this weapon requires. Empty = no heavy requirement. Mech weapons are additionally limited by the race's weapon filter (tags / tech / class); when that filter is enabled it bypasses the body-size gate.
